title: WaterColor "Magnolia House" 592 Western Lake Drive
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Per WaterColor Community guidelines the maximum number of wristbands this home is allotted is 10 bands to access WaterColor amenities and community pools- Located in the beautiful Park community of WaterColor- Close to the Watercolor Cerulean Park, nearby the Boathouse, and Lakehouse Pool- Surrounded by natural green space and parks- Close proximity to shops, restaurants and beach club- Pet Friendly*- 6 Passenger low speed vehicle- 4 Bikes- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutGuests staying in WaterColor will have access to the newly expanded WaterColor Beach Club. It features a new main pool and lounge area, a second pool deck with additional lounge seating, and a third pool with zero-entry, as well as an enhanced WaterColor Grill, and a new sunset bar, Costa Chica. All have scenic views of the Gulf of Mexico.DETAILS: Sun-drenched days of coastal fun await at Magnolia House, a 4-bedroom, 4.5-bathroom WaterColor home that sleeps 10. Located in the Lake District across the street from the Lakehouse Pool and Boathouse, this home offers access to WaterColor’s numerous resort-style amenities, including the private beach and beach club!A spacious front yard and wraparound porch welcome guests to this 3-story haven. Kick back and relax in the balmy breeze while grilling up a seafood feast on the natural gas grill. Head inside to find a reverse-floor plan layout with a mix of sleeping accommodations on the first floor. The beautiful primary bedroom has a king bed, a private bathroom, and front porch access. Additionally, there’s a kid-friendly bunk room with 2 twin-over-twin beds and a guest bedroom with 1 queen bed and 1 twin-over-twin bunk bed nook. A grocery lift for easily stocking the kitchen and a washer and dryer add convenience for a worry-free vacation!Discover beachy blue hues, crisp whites, and hardwood floors beneath a stunning vaulted ceiling in the stylish second-level great room. Enjoy sunny mornings sipping mimosas and cooking brunch in the chef’s kitchen, boasting granite countertops, high-end appliances, and a breakfast bar for 4. After a day at the beach, kids can play board games around the 10-person dining table while adults lounge in the living area or gather the whole family for a movie night on the 70” TV! Venture out the glass doors where a cozy seating area and a 4-person table offer spots to unwind on the screened-in porch. The second primary bedroom with a king bed and private bathroom is on this level.On the top floor, mix a nightcap at the wet bar before enjoying the endless view from the patio table in the crow’s nest.Numerous outdoor spaces, outstanding community amenities, and a spectacular location make Magnolia House an ideal WaterColor getaway. There’s parking for 2-3 vehicles in the driveway, and guests can leisurely explore on the complimentary 4 adult bikes. For beach access, choose between the WaterColor Beach Club or the beachSLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (Sleeps 10):FIRST FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed and Twin-over-Twin Bunk Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower Tub Combo- Bunk Room: Two Twin-over-Twin Bunk Beds- Bathroom with Shower Only in Garage AreaSECOND FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub SeparateTHIRD FLOOR:- Tower with Wet Bar*This home welcomes up to 2 dogs with an additional, non-refundable pet fee of $250, per pet, plus tax.*Weddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments, as well as be subject to fines.*Guests who are 25 years of age or younger must be accompanied by a responsible parent or guardian in any vacation rental managed by Callista by 360 Blue.

All have scenic views of the Gulf of Mexico. DETAILS: Sun-drenched days of coastal fun await at Magnolia House, a 4-bedroom, 4.5-bathroom WaterColor home that sleeps 10. Located in the Lake District across the street from the Lakehouse Pool and Boathouse, this home offers access to WaterColor’s numerous resort-style amenities, including the private beach and beach club! A spacious front yard and wraparound porch welcome guests to this 3-story haven. Kick back and relax in the balmy breeze while grilling up a seafood feast on the natural gas grill. Head inside to find a reverse-floor plan layout with a mix of sleeping accommodations on the first floor. The beautiful primary bedroom has a king bed, a private bathroom, and front porch access. Additionally, there’s a kid-friendly bunk room with 2 twin-over-twin beds and a guest bedroom with 1 queen bed and 1 twin-over-twin bunk bed nook. A grocery lift for easily stocking the kitchen and a washer and dryer add convenience for a worry-free vacation! Discover beachy blue hues, crisp whites, and hardwood floors beneath a stunning vaulted ceiling in the stylish second-level great room. Enjoy sunny mornings sipping mimosas and cooking brunch in the chef’s kitchen, boasting granite countertops, high-end appliances, and a breakfast bar for 4. After a day at the beach, kids can play board games around the 10-person dining table while adults lounge in the living area or gather the whole family for a movie night on the 70” TV! Venture out the glass doors where a cozy seating area and a 4-person table offer spots to unwind on the screened-in porch. The second primary bedroom with a king bed and private bathroom is on this level. On the top floor, mix a nightcap at the wet bar before enjoying the endless view from the patio table in the crow’s nest. Numerous outdoor spaces, outstanding community amenities, and a spectacular location make Magnolia House an ideal WaterColor getaway. There’s parking for 2-3 vehicles in the driveway, and guests can leisurely explore on the complimentary 4 adult bikes.
